topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Sifting through the soil behind the old oak, my fingers hook onto something hard, a discovery unexpected as a rainbow on a cloudy day. It's a time capsule, dusty and partially buried, nothing flashy, just a simple metal box. As I brush off the dirt, the sun seems to brighten, and a breeze whispers encouragement. The capsule is heavy with secrets, history curled up inside, waiting to share stories. I can almost hear them, the tales of the past, eager to meet the present. Opening it will be a journey, a delightful peek into a forgotten chapter, a connection to someone—perhaps a younger me, perhaps a stranger—who felt the same thrill of legacy, of leaving a piece of themselves for the future to find.
